description: We are a group of amateur astronomy lovers. By adapting SI era tools, we wish to add some Gen Z element into the space exploration. Let us march on Mars light-heartly~
summary:
What if humanity could one day live beyond Earth? Our journey begins with Mars, the Red Planet, a fascinating world holding clues to its ancient past and potential for future exploration.
We are a group of astronomy enthusiasts from Wong Nai Siong Secondary School, passionate about uncovering the mysteries of Mars. We selected Mars because its distinctive landscapes and geological formations provide compelling evidence of ancient water activity. In particular, the Gediz Vallis region offers valuable geological clues that help scientists reconstruct Mars' environmental history and investigate whether conditions once existed to support life.
Beyond understanding Mars, studying its geology, atmosphere, and extreme environment can advance our knowledge of planetary science and prepare humanity for exploring other potentially significant planets, including Jupiter's moon Europa and Saturn's moon Titan.
Our project, "Exploring Mars: Challenges and Solutions," investigates the planet's environmental conditions, geological characteristics, and major obstacles to human exploration. We aim to identify innovative and practical solutions that could make future human missions to Mars safer and more sustainable.
One planet. Countless mysteries. One extraordinary journey. Let's explore Mars!
details:
What secrets lie hidden within the winding valleys of the Red Planet? Join us on an exciting journey to Gediz Vallis, a mysterious canyon nestled at the foot of Mount Sharp in Mars’ Gale Crater. Guided by NASA’s Curiosity rover discoveries, we will explore a landscape shaped by ancient water flows, powerful debris movements and dry avalanches nearly three billion years ago. Every boulder, rocky ridge and winding channel holds a clue to Mars’ watery past. Even more intriguing is the unexpected discovery of pure white elemental sulfur stones, adding another mystery to unravel.

Through this project, we aim to equip fellow astronomers with detailed maps, geographical references and environmental parameters to navigate and investigate this fascinating Martian landscape. We hope these resources will inspire future exploration missions, bringing us closer to uncovering how Gediz Vallis was formed, why sulfur exists in this unusual location, and what these discoveries reveal about the evolution of Mars and our Solar System.

We use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Capcut to gather information for this project. The data, and photos are from the NASA resources page on Mars exploration. We hope to create an exploration contex for the audience, yet real reference parameters for the future astronauts. In a nutshell, we hope our production provide inspiration and reference for current and next generation to explore exoplanet worlds. We have created a exploration video as our main production, aiming the secondary school students or adults. Another creative team member has also created a game for schoolkids, as the additional production (Link: 火星探索：格迪兹河谷 3D, bilingual game, preferable play on PC). The journey to unlock the Red Planet’s ancient secrets starts here!
